name: clouddrive
description: CloudDrive: no-build Bootstrap UI, Git-based Cloudflare Deploy button, D1 migrations and secure R2 sharing

scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:integration
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy:code

DB.description: Stores users, permissions, uploads, shares, trash and audit metadata in D1.

PRIVATE_BUCKET.description: Private R2 bucket. Do NOT enable r2.dev or a public custom domain for this bucket.

PUBLIC_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for deliberately public file copies. The Worker can serve them before a CDN domain is configured.

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Set a unique random secret (32+ characters, preferably 64 hexadecimal characters). Required only for the first super-admin account. Do NOT reuse the example placeholder or commit the token.
